body:
We needed GPU-compatible singleton type dispatch for RootSolvers use in Thermodynamics.jl. It turns out (thanks to @dennisYatunin) we can achieve this with the existing code simply by dispatching over the root solver method *type*.

The PR documents how to do this. It also enhances the find_zero broadcasting interface by adding default values (soltype, tol, maxiters) to the type-dispatch methods (e.g., find_zero(f, ::Type{SecantMethod}, ...)), to allow users to broadcast method types succinctly (e.g., find_zero.(f, SecantMethod, x0, x1)) without specifying all optional arguments.
title: Document dispatch over method types for GPU
